hub.name: orders events and tags them with the subscription
a turn end without an outcome, and one with an empty reason
a report only to its caller
a session that leaves the views without a release vanishes without a word
a state change with no activity shows on the poll

hub.name: a reader at the edge of the ring loses nothing
